_desc: 独立运镜库。与舞蹈动作完全分离，可自由组合搭配。

static_wide.prompt: static wide shot, centered composition, full body visible from head to toe

slow_dolly_in.prompt: slow smooth dolly in movement, camera gliding from wide shot to medium shot

dolly_out.prompt: gradual dolly out movement, camera pulling back to reveal full scene and environment

orbit_close.prompt: slow orbital camera movement circling around the subject at close range, 3/4 body framing

orbit_wide.prompt: wide orbital pan circling the subject at medium distance, full body with environment visible

low_angle_push.prompt: low angle camera looking up at subject, slowly pushing forward, empowering and dynamic perspective

tracking_side.prompt: smooth side tracking shot following the subject, camera moving horizontally in sync with movement

fpv_follow.prompt: dynamic first-person-view style camera following behind and around the subject with fluid motion

crane_down.prompt: crane shot starting high above and descending to eye level, revealing the subject from above

handheld_close.prompt: intimate handheld camera held close to subject, slight natural gentle movement, documentary energy

top_down.prompt: top-down aerial view looking straight down at subject from directly above, abstract and cinematic

tilt_up.prompt: slow tilt from feet upward to face, gradually revealing the full outfit from bottom to top
